events.description: Monica Geller says Joey Tribbiani talked to Joey Tribbiani Sr.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani Sr. is going to keep cheating on Gloria Tribbiani, which is what Gloria Tribbiani wanted.
Joey Tribbiani says Gloria Tribbiani is going to keep pretending she doesn't know about Joey Tribbiani Sr.'s affair even though Gloria Tribbiani knows about it.
Joey Tribbiani says Tina can't see Tina's husband anymore.
Joey Tribbiani says Tina's husband got a restraining order.
Joey Tribbiani says the restraining order that Tina's husband got has nothing to do with anything.
Joey Tribbiani says he found out about Tina's husband's restraining order today.
Chandler Bing says things have changed on Waltons Mountain.
Ross Geller asks whether Joey Tribbiani is okay.
Joey Tribbiani says he guesses he is okay.
Joey Tribbiani says the situation is about parents.
Joey Tribbiani says that after a certain point people have to let go of their parents.
Joey Tribbiani says that people sometimes know better than their parents.
Joey Tribbiani says people have to let their parents make their own mistakes.
Rachel Green tells everyone to think about the fact that in a couple of years the group will turn into their parents.
Rachel Green says that in a couple of years Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing will turn into their parents.
Chandler Bing says he might turn into his parents.
Chandler Bing says that if that happens he will be an alcoholic blond who chases after twenty-year-old boys.
Chandler Bing says that alternatively he will end up like Nora Tyler Bing.
Monica Geller asks how things are going.
Phoebe Buffay says she broke up with Roger.
Rachel Green asks what happened with Phoebe Buffay and Roger.
Phoebe Buffay says she doesn't know why she broke up with Roger.
Phoebe Buffay says she means that Roger is a good person for her.
Phoebe Buffay says Roger is a good person.
Phoebe Buffay says Roger can be really sweet.
Phoebe Buffay says she thinks Roger is so right for her.
Phoebe Buffay says the situation with Roger is just that she hates Roger.
Phoebe Buffay says she hates Roger.
